text:
Alex Kim: heads up — Orbit Alliance ran into a hard blocker on the private deploy for AcmeHealth, their SI says the image signs but deployment fails during post-install network calls. Can @Priya take the lead on the architecture review?
Priya Menon: on it. do we have the failing logs or the kube events? also who from Orbit Alliance is on call?
Alex Kim: partner contact is Evan (orbit-evan). paste from the installer: `Failed to fetch /metadata/keys: dial tcp 10.0.0.5:443: connect: network is unreachable`
Mike Carter: that looks like egress/nat issue — private VPC has no proxy route to our image registry or KMS. we should validate routes + NAT gateway setup.
Jordan Patel: +1. also confirm HSM/KMS endpoints are reachable from their VPC. for govcloud customers the hostnames differ.
Priya Menon: Evan sent this note: "we're on-prem VPC peered to customer edge, only outbound 443 allowed to a small set of IPs". sounds like image registry IPs not in their allowlist.
Sarah Li: can we provide the IP ranges for our registry and KMS? need to give partner a minimal ACL.
Mike Carter: registry ranges: 34.128.0.0/14, 35.224.0.0/12 (example only). KMS endpoints are region-specific — better to provide FQDNs.
Priya Menon: Evan also mentioned image signing verification against marketplace attestation. if we provide FQDNs they can SNI allow. can engineering give official list and a short runbook?
Alex Kim: @Jordan can you draft a 1-pager runbook: ports, FQDNs, cert thumbprint check, fallback plan (use hosted relay)? need to share with Orbit Alliance PS by EOD.
Jordan Patel: will do. draft will include: 443 outbound to registry, 443 to kms.<region>.redwood-inference.com, icmp for health checks optional, and where to add marketplace cert pinning.
Oncall Bot: Incident #P-2023-842 created for Orbit Alliance private deploy; severity: medium; assignee: Priya Menon.
Priya Menon: quick checklist for the partner: 1) ensure NAT/egress IPs include registry ranges OR allow FQDN via proxy; 2) validate route to kms.<region>.redwood-inference.com:443; 3) confirm marketplace signing cert chain present; 4) attach `kubectl -n redwood logs` snippet if still failing.
Alex Kim: Evan said they can't change perimeter ACLs without a change window. is there a short-term fallback?
Mike Carter: we can enable relay via Dedicated staging pool — partner can push images to our staging registry via SFTP and we can mirror to their subnet during window. needs ops approval.
Priya Menon: ops approval required + estimated 3 hours. Evan asked for an ETA for a go/no-go call.
Jordan Patel: I'll propose a timeline in the runbook: immediate test steps (10-20m), mirror fallback (3h), full fix (change window).
Sarah Li: also flag this to Marketplace team — image attestation might block mirror. Jordan — include steps to sign and attest mirrored images.
Priya Menon: copying orbit-evan in email shortly. Evan, can you post `kubectl describe pod` and the installer output here after your change window?
Alex Kim: thanks everyone. will follow up after Evan replies. :thumbsup:
Evan (orbit-evan): (posted later) tried proxy config, still get TLS handshake while fetching keys. sending logs to Priya."
